catalyst_rows.indication: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) - insulin-deficient (COVALENT-211) and GLP-1 RA-treated (COVALENT-212)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: First patients dosed in the Phase II COVALENT-211 and COVALENT-212 clinical trials of icovamenib in type 2 diabetes (T2D); both trials are on track with topline 26-week data expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

catalyst_rows.asset: BMF-650 (next-generation oral GLP-1 RA, GLP-131 trial)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: The Phase I GLP-131 (BMF-650) obesity clinical trial is on track; initial 28-day weight reduction data expected in the second quarter of 2026.

Topline data from the Phase II COVALENT-112 clinical trial evaluating icovamenib in T1D patients were reported from the 52-week follow-up: A 52% increase from baseline in mean C-peptide AUC at Week 12, after completion of the dosing period, in patients diagnosed within 0-3 years (n=5) receiving icovamenib 200 mg ... Persistence observed through Week 52.

Comprehensive dataset to be presented at the American Diabetes Association's (ADA) Scientific Sessions (abstract is preliminary until time of presentation; full release scheduled for June 5, 2026 at 6:30 pm CDT).

catalyst_rows.indication: Recently diagnosed type 1 diabetes (T1D) - investigator-sponsored Phase 2
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Planning a Phase II trial in recently diagnosed T1D patients (≤ 3 years since diagnosis), in collaboration with four U.S. academic centers ... trial initiation expected in the second half of the year at leading centers including the Barbara Davis Center for Diabetes, Joslin Diabetes Center, University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio Diabetes Division, and the University of Miami Diabetes Research Institute.
